enemy-050-korari-stalker.note: Active sources were already calibrated in the standalone V66 recomposition; all active rigid medians agree. Documentary transformed measurements support factors1. No second scale correction.

measurements.note: Prior documented endpoints were transformed once into the already-calibrated active source cell using the recorded uniform clip factor and recomposition origin. The resulting active-source overlay was inspected directly: posterior croup to anterior shoulder, excluding neck, tail, fur and legs. This documentary conversion never scales source pixels. Factors remain 1; flexion/occlusion and +/-5px uncertainty remain visible rather than replaced with invented perfect per-frame lengths.
